body.statement: In the recursive finite-SCM setting with an acyclic causal diagram, an unnested counterfactual probability is identifiable from a specified collection of observational and experimental distributions if and only if \(\mathsf{ctfID}\) returns an expression for it.

source.locator: Theorem 5 (\(\mathsf{ctfID}\) completeness), arXiv:2107.03190v2, source file main.tex, lines 613--615
source.verbatim_statement: A counterfactual probability \(P(\mathbf Y_*=\mathbf y_*)\) is identifiable from \(\mathbf Z\) and \(\mathcal G\) if and only if \(\mathsf{ctfID}\) returns an expression for it.

attestation.note: Transcribed from Theorem 5 in the arXiv:2107.03190v2 source file main.tex.
